title: Folding Patterns
summary: A browser tool that generates accordion, pleated and Kresling folding patterns and previews them in 3D. A lampshade version exports the flat pattern as a 1:1 PDF ready to print and cut.

title: Seen Through
title_zh: 透明公廁的環境知覺調查
summary: A phone-based study of Shigeru Ban's transparent public toilet in Haru-no-Ogawa Community Park, Tokyo. Participants pick a booth and live through four visual boundaries in it: always opaque, always frosted, frosted on locking (the real design) and always clear. They rate privacy and safety before entering and after locking, and answers go straight to Google Sheets. The project page explains the method and lists its references.
